title: The Retainage a Project Is Treated as Holding
content:
# The Retainage a Project Is Treated as Holding

The retainage a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is treated as holding is the figure on its record, except where more was withheld from the progress billings than the class's rate allows.

## Rule

Where a withholding on the project was taken at more than the rate the project's class withholds, measured against the progress billings it was withheld from, the retainage held is recomputed at the class's rate on those progress billings and the retainage already released is taken off it.

Where every withholding was taken at the class's rate and retainage stands withheld on the project, the retainage held is the retainage withheld on the record less the retainage already released.

Where no retainage stands withheld on the project, nothing is held.

## How the rate is measured

The retainage the class's rate calls for is the total of the progress billings raised on the project taken at the class's retainage rate and rounded to the nearest cent. A recorded total above that figure by more than 0.01 USD, one cent, is a withholding taken at more than the class's rate; a recorded total within one cent of it, or below it, is taken as at the class's rate.

| Retainage recorded as withheld | The class's rate on the progress billings | Retainage already released | Retainage held |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 15000 | USD 12000 | USD 0 | USD 12000, recomputed at the class's rate |
| USD 12000 | USD 12000 | USD 2000 | USD 10000, the record less the release |
| USD 11000 | USD 12000 | USD 0 | USD 11000, the record less the release |
| USD 0 | USD 12000 | USD 0 | nothing |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

Progress billings on a project come to USD 240000 and its class withholds 5 per cent, so the class's rate calls for USD 12000. The record shows USD 15000 withheld and USD 1000 already released. Because 15000 is above 12000 by more than one cent, the retainage held is 12000 less 1000, USD 11000.
